mechanics.summary: Blizzard announced a 30% reduction to health and damage of all Firelands bosses and other enemies at 4.4.2 launch, implemented by Power of Stormrage; General Taldris Moonfall can deactivate it.
Beth begins on the fiery web; groups split between web-level boss duty and ground-level add duty. Filaments move players between regions.
Fire Energy drains; at zero Beth casts an 8-second lethal Smoldering Devastation. Three reported casts precede descent.
Venom Rain pressures ground players while Beth is on the web; Ember Flare pressures web players.

values.suppression_rule: web presence suppresses ground Venom Rain per current guide

mechanics.summary: Meteor Burn selects a web player, damages nearby players, and burns a hole in the web.
Spinners descend on filaments at pull and after devastations; hanging Spinners cast Burning Acid until controlled.

values.spawn_timing: pull and after each devastation/about1.5m guide wording

mechanics.summary: A Drone appears about every 45 seconds; its energy, frontal cone, random acid, and Spiderling Consume create the ground priority.

values.consume_stack_delta: +20% damage and +20% movement speed per Spiderling
values.heroic_fixate: random ground player for10s; 75% reduced Drone damage

mechanics.summary: Spiderlings run from ground lanes toward high-threat targets and can be consumed by a Drone or Beth.

mechanics.summary: Heroic-only Broodlings are reported to fixate players and detonate on contact; current sources disagree on kill/soak semantics and exact damage.

mechanics.summary: After three devastations Beth descends, no new adds are reported, and a Frenzy/Widow's Kiss soft-enrage begins.

values.widows_kiss_guide_effect: 10% healing reduction every2s with nearby-ally consequence
values.consume: Beth can consume remaining Spiderlings and heal
